examples.description: The newest 20 e-invoices, to pick one for its field sheet

preconditions: Rows carry no field sheet; myinvois_invoice_read returns portal_field_sheet for one e-invoice. The UBL 2.1 XML copy is GET /api/myinvois/invoices/{id}/xml, for records; nothing is emailed or submitted to LHDN.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.
